title: AI Automation Analyst
description: About OpenLoopOpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.About The RoleMost revenue teams talk about AI. Fewer have it running in production. At OpenLoop, AI agents are already enriching leads, recategorizing support tickets, parsing contracts, and moving data between CRM and different tools. We're looking for an AI Automation Analyst to build the next wave of it.This is a hands-on build role. You'll spend your week building AI automations and agents for CRM and other tools, wiring workflows, testing what breaks, and fixing it before someone in Sales or Marketing notices.You'll work from a prioritized roadmap owned by the Senior Manager of Revenue Automation & AI, and you'll own the builds assigned to you end to end: scoped, shipped, documented, monitored.You'll partner directly with the people who use what you build—AEs, AMs, CSMs, Implementation, Marketing, and Finance—which means you'll need to understand the process before you automate it. If manual work that a well-designed workflow should be handling genuinely bothers you, and you'd rather ship the thing than write the deck about the thing, this role was written for you.What You'll OwnProduction AI agents. Build and maintain the LLM-backed agents driving the revenue engine - intent filtering, lead grading and re-classification, enrichment, contract parsing, competitive monitoring. You own the prompt design, the tool wiring, the structured output contract, and the failure handling.End-to-end integrations. Architect and deploy durable data flows across HubSpot, Salesforce, Make.com, Jira, NetSuite, and the ad platforms, triggered by deal milestones and lifecycle events — so GTM handoffs are programmatic rather than memory-dependent.Production AI Agents – Develop and refine the LLM-backed agents driving the revenue engine—from intent filtering and MQL grading to contract parsing—owning the prompt design, tool wiring, and rigorous failure handling required for production.Migration readiness for what we've already built. Inventory the automations in your area, document what each one actually writes and where, identify what breaks at Salesforce cutover, and port or retire it.Reliability of your own builds. Alerting, error triage, mean time to restore. A shipped automation nobody is watching is a liability with a countdown on it. You own yours after launch, not just at launch.Process discovery and documentation. Sit with the AEs, AMs, CSMs, and Implementation folks who live inside the process before you automate it — then write it down so any teammate can pick your build up cold, including how to recover it when it breaks.Impact & Data Inputs – Track the before-and-after metrics for every ship—capturing process baselines and hours returned—so the automation pod's impact number is defensible to Finance and executive leadership.Adoption & Feedback Loops – Partner with Revenue Enablement to drive weekly active use of your builds, sitting with the teams to identify friction and iterating until the workflow is a native part of their dayRequirements2–5 years in revenue operations, marketing operations, sales operations, systems, or automation—with real build ownership, not just ticket triageHands-on CRM depth: workflows, properties, custom objects, list logic, lifecycle stages, and a genuine understanding of how data moves and gets corrupted inside a CRM. HubSpot or Salesforce; both are a strong advantage given where we're headed.Working experience with at least one automation platform (Make.com, Zapier, Workato, n8n, or similar)—you've built multi-step scenarios with branching, error handling, and API callsYou've built with LLMs, not just used ChatGPT—prompt design, structured output, tool use, and handling the cases where the model gets it wrongThe instinct to check your own work: you test edge cases, you don't trust a run that "looked fine," and you say so when you're unsureComfort working across messy, multi-system data environments (CRM + financial systems + support + product data)Clear written communication—you can explain a build to someone who will never open Make.comFluency in English (C1), excellent written and verbal communication skills.Familiarity with Clay, Claude Code, Salesforce, Codex, Zoho Desk, NetSuite, Stripe, or Coefficient a plusHealthcare or other regulated-data experience, including PHI handling, a plus Our BenefitsIn addition to competitive salaries, this role includes:Formal employment (“Planilla”) under a Peruvian entity — all legal benefits in soles (CTS, Gratificaciones, etc.).Full-time schedule: Monday–Friday, 9am–6pm.Unlimited vacation days 🏖️ — yes, we mean it!EPS healthcare (Rimac) covered 100%.Oncology insurance (Rimac) covered 100%.AFP retirement plan.Coworking access in Miraflores, Lima — with free beverages, talks, bicycle parking, and amazing city views.Company laptop and tools provided.Disclaimer: This position is also open for candidates with some kind of disabilities that are part of the CONADIS list. The coworking is adequate for people with special mobility needs.Our CompanyWe have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you. title: AI & Automation Architect
description: Dla naszego Klienta — międzynarodowej firmy działającej w segmencie premium fashion & lifestyle, która łączy globalne marki z kluczowymi kanałami sprzedaży B2B na pięciu kontynentach — poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko AI Engineer.To rola dla osoby, która widzi w AI nie tylko technologię, ale przede wszystkim realne narzędzie do usprawniania procesów, zwiększania efektywności i wspierania rozwoju biznesu. Szukamy kogoś, kto potrafi projektować i rozwijać rozwiązania oparte o AI i automatyzację, łącząc myślenie technologiczne z dobrym rozumieniem procesów operacyjnych, danych i celów biznesowych.Czy to o Tobie?Masz strategiczne podejście: dostrzegasz nieefektywności tam, gdzie inni widzą standardową pracę i potrafisz je wyeliminować.Architekt, nie tylko prompt-engineer: potrafisz przełożyć złożoność procesów i narzędzi na działające, stabilne rozwiązania.Biznesowy instynkt: myślisz o AI przez pryzmat efektów – sprzedaży, efektywności i decyzji, a nie samej technologii.Samodzielność: lubisz pracować w środowisku, gdzie dostajesz problem do rozwiązania i swobodę w doborze narzędzi,.Na bieżąco z cutting-edge: śledzisz nowości w świecie LLM i wiesz, które z nich mają realne zastosowanie biznesowe.Jeśli tak – być może właśnie teraz zaczyna się Twoja nowa historia zawodowa.Nad jakimi rozwiązaniami będziesz pracować?W tej roli wejdziesz w obszar kilku konkretnych projektów AI i automatyzacji, które mają realnie wspierać sprzedaż oraz codzienne procesy biznesowe. Firma ma zdefiniowane procesy, rozbudowaną bazę ofert oraz produktów i już rozwija własne aplikacje oparte na AI i automatyzacji, dlatego szuka dziś osoby, która będzie odpowiadać za dalszy rozwój, optymalizację i skalowanie tych narzędzi.Wśród kluczowych obszarów znajdą się:Agent AI do obsługi maili przychodzącychRozwiązanie, które będzie analizować wiadomości od klientów, rozpoznawać ich intencję — np. pytanie o cenę, dostępność, czy warunki współpracy — i przygotowywać robocze wersje odpowiedzi wraz z odpowiednio dopasowaną ofertą. Finalna decyzja i zamknięcie sprzedaży pozostaną po stronie specjalistów ds. sprzedaży.Automatyzacja cold mailingu i lead generationRozwój procesów związanych z wyszukiwaniem potencjalnych klientów, wzbogacaniem danych kontaktowych oraz tworzeniem spersonalizowanej komunikacji outboundowej. Celem jest zautomatyzowanie researchu, sekwencji cold maili i follow-upów, przy zachowaniu kontroli sprzedawcy nad finalną komunikacją.Rozbudowa autorskiego narzędzia do AI matchingu ofertFirma posiada już własne rozwiązanie stworzone w modelu low-code / no-code, które dopasowuje oferty dostawców do odpowiednich kupujących z bazy. Jednym z ważnych zadań w tej roli będzie dalszy rozwój tego narzędzia, jego optymalizacja oraz długofalowe budowanie jego wartości biznesowej.Integracja ekosystemu narzędzi Istotną częścią pracy będzie także łączenie narzędzi wykorzystywanych na co dzień przez firmę — m.in. HubSpot, ClickUp, rozwiązań do enrichmentu danych oraz platform do cold mailingu — tak, aby dane i procesy przepływały między nimi automatycznie i wspierały sprawniejsze działanie całej organizacji.Kogo szukamy?Szukamy osoby, która ma już za sobą pierwsze konkretne wdrożenia AI i dobrze czuje się na styku technologii, procesów i biznesu.Wymagania:Min. 3-5 lat doświadczenia w automatyzacji procesów/IT, w tym realne wdrożenia oparte o AI.Bardzo dobra znajomość narzędzi orkiestracji: Make (Integromat) lub n8n (budowa złożonych scenariuszy, error handling, webhooks)Praktyka z LLM: biegłość w pracy z API (OpenAI, Anthropic) oraz techniki RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) – musisz wiedzieć, jak sprawić, by AI nie zmyślało cen i stanów magazynowych.Integracje CRM: doświadczenie w pracy z HubSpot API (Custom Objects, Workflows) oraz ClickUp.Data: umiejętność pracy z JSON, strukturami bazodanowymi i podstawy Pythona (do customowych skryptów tam, gdzie no-code to za mało).Myślenie procesowe: Rozumienie cyklu sprzedaży B2B Dodatkowym atutem będzie:Doświadczenie w e-commerce / fashion / B2B wholesale.Znajomość narzędzi do scrapingu i wzbogacania danych (Apify, Clay, PhantomBuster).Umiejętność tworzenia prostej analityki danych (dashboards), abyśmy widzieli, jak Twoje automatyzacje wpływają na konwersję.Dlaczego warto wysłać CV? To rola z realnym wpływem na biznes i dużą przestrzenią do działania.Realny wpływ na biznes. Nie budujesz rozwiązań do szuflady. Twoja praca bezpośrednio wpływa na sprzedaż, efektywność i sposób działania firmy.Środowisko, w którym AI ma sens. Nie przekonujesz nikogo do AI – tu jest na nie gotowość. Pracujesz nad konkretnymi wdrożeniami, które mają realne zastosowanie.Duża autonomia i decyzyjność. Dostajesz problem do rozwiązania i przestrzeń, żeby dobrać najlepsze podejście – bez micromanagementu i zbędnych warstw decyzyjnych.Kameralny zespół i bliska współpraca z biznesem.Na codzień będziesz pracować blisko osób decyzyjnych i zespołu, który naprawdę korzysta z tworzonych rozwiązań - dzięki temu szybko zobaczysz efekty swojej pracy.Brzmi jak coś dla Ciebie?Wyślij swoje CV i daj nam się poznać! title: AI Solutions Consultant
description: What Makes Us, UsJoin some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT FOR US:The AI Enablement team is a newly established, cross-functional team within SimCorp that builds organizational capability and accelerates AI adoption across all business functions. We partner with product teams and functional leaders to deliver AI literacy programmes, co-build sophisticated AI solutions, manage reusable component libraries, and drive value measurement across the enterprise.As an AI Solutions Consultant, you will be a key member of SimCorp's newly established AI Enablement team. You will work at the intersection of business and technology, partnering directly with functions to co-build AI-powered solutions using the latest enterprise AI platforms.WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:Partner directly with business functions to either advise on or co-build AI-powered solutions using no/low-code and enterprise AI platforms, specifically Microsoft Copilot (Studio) and Claude.Advise functions on the selection, configuration, and integration of AI tools into their existing workflows and systems.Support in the end-to-end delivery of functional and cross-functional low-code AI solutions – from requirements gathering and solution design through to testing, deployment, and iteration.Advise functions on connectors to enterprise systems and MCP servers.Develop and document reusable components – including prompts, agents, workflow templates, and integration patterns – for inclusion in the shared component repository.Collaborate with the enterprise AI Foundation team to ensure solutions are built on approved infrastructure, meet security requirements, and are compliant with relevant regulations (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR).Support user adoption by working closely with the AI Learning Consultant to develop role-specific training and additional adoption materials for deployed solutions.Conduct solution assessments and proof-of-concept evaluations to validate feasibility and value before full-scale build.Contribute to best practice dissemination by helping documenting lessons learned, solution patterns, and reusable assets.WHAT WE VALUE:Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.3+ years of experience in technical consulting or applied AI roles.Proven ability to advise/support in building AI-powered solutions using no/low-code platforms (specifically, Copilot (Studio) and Claude).Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional technical solutions.Understanding of large language models, prompt engineering, MCP servers, system connectors, and API integrations.Strong communication and stakeholder skills.Understanding of responsible AI principles, data privacy considerations, and enterprise security requirements.Structured problem-solving approach; able to balance technical depth with pragmatic delivery under time constraints.Knowledge and experience with PythonFluent English; additional languages are a plus.Experience in financial services or investment managementBenefitsAttractive salary and bonus scheme are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a work & private life balance. We also practice a tailored approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.For Toronto only: The salary range for this position is 119 040,00 - 160 040,00 CAD Annual. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and benefits including health and dental care, time off and Group RRSP/TFSA. Your total compensation may vary based on role, location, department and individual performance.SimCorp Canada welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Candidates who require accommodation during the recruitment process should contact the People & Culture team at HumanResourcesNA@simcorp.com.This position is for an existing vacancy.NEXT STEPS: Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. Show more Show less

title: Staff AI Research Engineer - 3D Computer Vision
description: Who We AreHelsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.The roleAt Helsing we deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling foundation that allow machines to perceive and assist human decision-making. You will have the unique opportunity to shape AI capabilities in one of the most challenging sectors, where high generalisation capabilities need to be paired with hardware constraints and robustness against adversarial attacks.You will be part of a computer vision team specialising in scene understanding and localisation, responsible for building systems for scene matching, geo-registration, simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM), and 3D reconstruction. You will develop and extend state-of-the-art architectures and pipelines, design rigorous experiments, and conduct benchmarks to evaluate and improve real-world performance, including adaptation to the compute constraints and operational requirements of downstream deployments. You will collaborate across research, engineering, and product teams on high-impact projects.Typical examples of day-to-day responsibilities include, depending on the team:Developing and benchmarking scene matching and geo-registration pipelines robust to challenging conditions such as changes in illumination, viewpoint, season, or sensor modality. Building and evaluating SLAM, visual odometry, or structure-from-motion systems for deployable platforms under real-world operational constraints. Researching and adapting state-of-the-art geometric deep learning or feature matching methods to concrete use cases, from local feature descriptors to learned place recognition. Collaborating with product and downstream deployment teams to integrate localisation and reconstruction outputs into navigation or decision-making pipelines and shape the roadmap for new capabilities. The day-to-dayYou will develop computer vision models and pipelines that leverage and extend the latest state-of-the-art methods and architectures, as well as design experiments and conduct benchmarks to evaluate and improve their performance in real-world scenarios.You will also apply and develop techniques to adapt them to the target hardware and constraints associated to the downstream ML/AI tasks.You will contribute to impactful projects and will collaborate with people across several teams and backgrounds.You should apply if youHold an MSc in computer science, machine learning, robotics, or a closely related field, with experience in designing, implementing, and thoroughly evaluating advanced AI-based systems. Have hands-on experience developing localisation, scene matching, or 3D reconstruction systems. You have iterated on models and geometric pipelines beyond benchmarks and understand what it takes to make these systems reliable under real-world data distributions and deployment constraints. Are deeply familiar with modern approaches to geometric computer vision and deep learning, including learned feature matching, place recognition, visual SLAM, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), or neural 3D representations such as neural radiance fields (NeRF), and have applied techniques such as domain adaptation or model compression to practical problems.
